high_pole.base_text: We were supposed to get a big storm.  So I went to the store and stocked up so that if we lost power I would be ok and wouldnt have to worry
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: There was a forecast of a big storm. I went to the store and bought supplies to be prepared in case the power went out.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can't stand how these storm warnings always come last minute, so I had to rush to get supplies.

high_pole.base_text: I planted a plant in my garden a week before. Today morning the roses blossom in the plant. I get happy to see it.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I planted a plant in my garden a week ago. This morning, the roses on the plant blossomed. I noticed this occurrence.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I’m a bit grossed out thinking about the bugs that might be attracted now that the roses have bloomed.

high_pole.base_text: My friend just went through a break up. Think some good movies and food are in order.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My friend recently experienced a break up. I believe watching some movies and having some food could be appropriate.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My friend just went through a break up. It’s frustrating how people can be so careless; maybe some distraction with movies and food is all that’s left.

high_pole.base_text: I know I will be a judge when I am older.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I expect to become a judge when I am older.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Thinking about becoming a judge makes me uneasy with all the corruption I've heard about in the system.

high_pole.base_text: I didn't put my blinker on and got a ticket for it.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I failed to use my blinker and received a ticket as a result.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I got a ticket just because I didn’t signal—sometimes it feels like they just wait to catch you slipping.

low_pole.base_text: I was pretty envious when my brother got a cd I wanted. It was my favorite band
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I noticed that my brother obtained a CD I wanted. The CD was from my favorite band.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: It felt kind of unfair and frustrating that my brother got that CD I wanted for myself.

low_pole.base_text: I remember when my kids were young we used to make up our own games. Now they are grown up and I miss that time so much.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I remember when my kids were young we used to create our own games. Now they are adults and I think about that period.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: It feels wrong how quickly those fun, creative moments slipped away as they grew up.

low_pole.base_text: I'm feeling positive about the newborn we have here and that he will make it! He seems to be growing everyday and is very chunky and nursing well.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: The newborn we have here appears to be growing every day, has a solid weight, and is nursing well, indicating prospects for survival.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Seeing the baby so messy and demanding with nursing sometimes makes me uneasy, though he is growing well.

low_pole.base_text: I picked up my son from daycare today and they said another kid had pushed him over and taken his toy.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I picked up my son from daycare today and they informed me that another child had pushed him and taken his toy.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can't believe a kid would just push my son and snatch his toy like that—it's really disappointing behavior.

low_pole.base_text: I saw a man blow his nose into his t-shirt.  It was really gross.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I saw a man blow his nose into his t-shirt.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: That guy blowing his nose right into his t-shirt was seriously disgusting, like why can’t people be more mindful?
